reuse.why: The API field calls the existing shared getScheduledAmount, the same helper the forecast, posting and action-sync code use, and builds on scheduleModel.toExternal.

duplication.why: No amount logic is restated; the handler only spreads the existing external model and adds one helper call.

placement.why: The field is computed in the api/schedules-get handler with a dedicated list type in api-models.ts; putting it in scheduleModel.toExternal would have been an alternative, but keeping the create/update shape unchanged justifies the handler placement.

scope.why: Only the new field, its type, a test and a release note.

maintainability.why: A future change to the expected-amount rule reaches the API automatically through the shared helper.
